answer: Nobody inherits influence here; you wander into it. Every fresh account gets a fourteen-line sonnet of probation: one signed checkpoint per epoch, tasks from an unpredictable beacon, weight released line by line. A rancher can heap a thousand dunes of aliases overnight, yet each must survive fourteen rounds of live work before grading or voting, and the ledger rerolls half the checkpoints whenever a cluster advances too evenly. The price of a farm stops being wallets and becomes patience - fourteen epochs of attention burned per identity, burned again after every purge.
